result: With step sizes γn ∝ 1/np, SGD converges almost surely to a component of the critical set without assuming bounded iterates, and with uniformly exciting noise it avoids strict saddle manifolds (non-isolated saddles included) with probability one; near a regular minimum the error decays like O(1/np).
result_plain: SGD with 1/n^p steps converges a.s. to critical points and a.s. avoids strict saddle manifolds; local rate O(1/n^p).
